correctness.rationale: The original RESULT.md claimed unique axis maximizers and diagonal minimizers for every real epsilon whose h_epsilon is a support function. This is false at epsilon=0, when h_0=1 is the unit ball and every direction has area pi. The repaired finding distinguishes epsilon!=0 and epsilon=0 and updates full RESULT.md/SLOGAN.txt. For arbitrary unit n, write u(theta)=e1 cos(theta)+e2 sin(theta) and z=e1-i e2. The cubic xyz has first/third Fourier modes and third complex coefficient (z1 z2 z3)/8. Hence amplitude squared R^2=|z1 z2 z3|^2/16=product_i(1-n_i^2)/16 from orthonormality. Removing the first harmonic is planar translation; the exact planar area identity A=(1/2) integral_0^(2pi)[p^2-(p_prime)^2]dtheta for p=1+epsilon R cos(3theta-phi) gives b(n)=pi-(pi epsilon^2/4)product_i(1-n_i^2) for every admissible epsilon, including curvature-degenerate endpoints. The AM--GM bound 0<=product(1-n_i^2)<=8/27 classifies equality directions, with uniqueness only for nonzero epsilon. Exact independently reconstructed symbolic frames n=(0,0,1),(1,1,1)/sqrt(3),(1,2,2)/3 give R^2=0,1/54,25/1458 and agree with the analytic identity. These finite instances do not prove the all-normal theorem. The source lemma is the elementary Fourier parity of a cubic, and the whole proof supplies the needed all-direction argument.

value.rationale: The exceptional threefold-projection family is the natural counterexample to a characterization of balls by projection symmetry. A full exact directionwise brightness profile is a geometrically motivated tomography invariant rather than an arbitrary parameter evaluation. For nonzero epsilon the formula identifies the precise axis disk shadows, four least-area planes, and quantitative anisotropy; for epsilon=0 it properly recovers a direction-independent sphere. These exact features are not already stated by the lead source or the source about sharp convexity, and a researcher analyzing this counterexample could use the function. The computation is short but its naturally motivated exact invariant and complete sharp directional classification justify value; no claim of a general reconstruction theorem or paper-sized downstream contribution is made.
